result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two designs are nearly identical. Each marks Studio with a 'Most popular' badge, a purple border, a filled button and a slight lift above the other cards. A's heading is more measured and stays under the recommended plan, and its Starter and Network buttons are neutral outlines, so those cards sit quieter. B's oversized heading and purple-outlined secondary buttons take some emphasis away from Studio, and its cards are cut off at the bottom of the screenshot. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both use the same pattern: a Most Popular pill, a purple border, a filled purple button and a soft shadow on Studio, with large prices and short checkmark lists. B lifts the Studio card above the others and gives the side cards neutral black-outlined buttons, so they look quieter while still belonging to the set. A pushes Studio downward, gives the side buttons purple outlines that compete more with Studio, and its cards run off the bottom of the screenshot.
